summary: Re-test of receipt-membership-line bug fix from iteration_6. All 4 scenarios pass. Bug fixed: receipt now snapshots remainingKg into receiptRemainingKg state BEFORE setMembers mutation, so the receipt displays the correct post-deduction value. No regressions on non-member flow.
critical_code_review_comments: POSScreen.jsx is 1693 lines (exceeded 700-line guideline) — recommend splitting MEMBER_PACKAGES, INITIAL_MEMBERS, TIER_STYLE constants and the Registration Modal into separate files. Carry-over from iteration_6.
Members registry remains client-side only (mocked) — already flagged as MOCKED.

Fix is correctly implemented: receiptRemainingKg, receiptUsedMembership, receiptMemberSnapshot states are set inside handleSave BEFORE setMembers; QR modal reads from snapshot state — decouples display from mutation timing.
seed_data_creation: n/a — INITIAL_MEMBERS hardcoded (Budi Santoso 12.5kg Gold, Andi Wijaya 25kg Platinum, Siti)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter_6 bug (receipt double-deduction showing 8.5 instead of 10.5 KG) is fully resolved. Verified via Playwright: (1) Budi Santoso 12.5−2.0 → receipt 10.5 KG + 'Hangus pada 18 Mei 2026'; (2) state persisted: badge after new-order shows 10.5 kg; (3) Andi Wijaya 25.0−5.0 → receipt 20.0 KG + 'Hangus pada 10 Juni 2026'; (4) Non-member Test User → QR modal opens with LUNAS badge, no receipt-membership-line. Screenshots confirm correct rendering. All flows tested via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL public endpoint.
rca of the issue: Iteration_6 RCA: derived useMemo `memberRemainingAfter = activeMember.remainingKg - kiloanKg` was rendered after setMembers had already deducted from the source state, causing double-subtraction. Fix in iter_7: handleSave snapshots `remainingAfter = max(0, activeMember.remainingKg - kiloanKg)` into `receiptRemainingKg` state BEFORE calling setMembers; QR modal renders `receiptRemainingKg.toFixed(1) KG` and uses `receiptMemberSnapshot` (cloned activeMember) for tier styling and expiry. Verified working.
